corePromise: Ordinary situations become impossible, unsettling, and unforgettable in under 45 seconds.
audience: Global English-speaking viewers who enjoy psychological horror, scary micro-stories, uncanny everyday situations, creepy fiction, and visually distinctive Shorts.

primaryFormat.shortsRole: Core channel identity and primary publishing surface.

storyCriteria: Hook lands within the first 1-1.5 seconds.
Premise is understandable from one sentence and one visual.
The situation begins ordinary enough to feel relatable.
The ending contains a twist, climax, or disturbing unresolved beat.
The story fits 20-45 seconds and normally 90-140 spoken words.
The story supports 4-7 distinct visual beats.
The premise and twist are not semantic duplicates of recent uploads.
The story remains effective without graphic gore.
avoid: Graphic gore as the main appeal.
Copyrighted horror characters or obvious story copies.
Long exposition before the threat appears.
anglePrinciples: Open on the unsettling contradiction before explanation.
Use one fear mechanism and escalate it.
Prefer implication, repetition, impossible sound, spatial contradiction, reflection, or message-based fear.
Make each visual beat materially change the viewer's understanding.
Preserve the strongest recontextualization for the ending.

thumbnailIdentity.objective: Create a scroll-stopping first frame and consistent Dark Stickman packaging without spoiling the twist.
principles: Dark charcoal/navy environment with restrained deep-red accent only when useful.
First frame is more important than thumbnail for Shorts.
No gore, clutter, bright colors, comedy, or childlike cartoon styling.

archetypes.label: Impossible Presence
archetypes.intent: A figure, shadow, reflection, or silhouette where it should not be.

archetypes.label: Wrong Space
archetypes.intent: A door, corridor, room, floor, mirror, or opening behaving impossibly.

archetypes.label: Signal Threat
archetypes.intent: A phone, message, camera, intercom, or recording reveals an impossible threat.

publishingCadence.initialPolicy: Start with 2-4 high-quality Shorts per day (target 3). Scale only when analytics confirms originality, retention, and production quality remain stable.
publishingCadence.schedulingPolicy: Autonomous mode assigns safe Shorts publish slots and later adapts timing from real channel audience data.
publishingCadence.qualityPolicy: Cadence is subordinate to originality and quality. Failed hook, twist, duplicate, brand, render, narration, caption, packaging, cadence, or upload gates reject or delay the item.

brandTagline: Short nightmares. Dark lines. One last twist.
channelDescription: Original psychological horror and scary micro-stories told in a minimal dark stickman style. New unsettling Shorts built around everyday situations, escalating tension, and a final twist.
